question:
Among the posts owned by an elder user, how many of them have a score of over 19?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: elder users refers to Age > 65; Score of over 19 refers to Score > = 20

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052
WHERE u.XCL_054 < '2010-01-01'
  AND p.XCL_030 > 19
